title.description: Short imperative action label under 60 characters for the suggested task chip and spawned session title.

prompt.description: Self-contained initial prompt for the spawned session, including file paths and enough context to act independently.

tldr.description: One or two plain-English sentences explaining what was noticed in this session and what the follow-up session will do, without file paths or code.

cwd.description: Optional absolute path to a different project root on this host when the follow-up belongs in another repository. Defaults to the current session folder.
